witness.branch: Parking near an obstruction on a narrow road.
witness.quote: Alongside or opposite any highway excavation or obstruction when stopping, standing or parking would obstruct traffic.
witness.reason: Narrow-road parking with an obstruction provides a direct physical setup, but narrowness does not decide whether traffic would be obstructed.
required_context: Establish highway dedication and public vehicular access, responsible person and covered vehicle characteristics.
Highway status and covered motor vehicle.
Narrow-road boundaries, obstruction footprint, parking approach and target.
Parking purpose and actual loading activity.
Preserve 'alongside or opposite', 'would obstruct traffic' and traffic-conflict necessity without numerical legal cutoffs.
Retain halt purpose, actual passenger or goods activity and all statutory exception circumstances.
Supply obstruction footprint, parking position, available passage and traffic trajectories.
Vehicle position alongside or opposite the obstruction.
witness.subject_reason: The selected available driver can perform the parking task with a covered motor vehicle.
